current_cases.issue1237_scope_correction: Issue1237 MIN-F02: Comparison with DSM590/1144 remains unresolved at complete chemical/preparation scope. JCM149 Metals44 prints EDTA·2Na and MnSO4·xH2O; DSM prints Na-EDTA and MnSO4·H2O plus a few drops of concentrated H2SO4. Unspecified hydration, salt detail or an unreported acid step does not prove incompatibility or equivalence. The historical malformed molybdate strings remain literal unresolved assertions. Positively different JCM149 outer Hutner mineral base has MgSO4·7H2O 14.45 g versus 29.7 g in JCM900/979; that outer recipe is distinct from the nested Metals44 reference. JCM631 also retains its positively different Mg/Ca quantities and vitamin inputs. All present immediate inputs remain unchanged; COMPLETE is source-list completeness, not resolved molecular identity.
